messages:
Dana Park: PolarWave (acct PW-503) requests a bespoke pilot discount: 25% off for 2 months + Net45 on pilot invoices. They're asking because a competitor quoted lower. Invoice ref: INV-2026-9902. Need Deal Desk approval.
Luis Moreno: Do we have usage/forecast for pilot? Is this overage or acquisition discount?
Dana Park: Acquisition discount tied to landing 3 paying customers within 90 days. Forecasted pilot spend ~$40k.
Harper Ng: Legal: must be explicit non-precedent language and conditionality (discount only if customers onboard). Also require signed pilot SOW and milestone acceptance.
BillingBot: System: INV-2026-9902 status: DRAFT. Ticket BILL-1155 opened.
Luis Moreno: Finance view: 25% seems high. Proposed counter: 15% for 60 days + Net45, with a performance clawback if they don't hit 3 customers (we'd invoice the difference).
Dana Park: Customer insists 25. They say they'll sign SOW today if we accept.
CFO_Michelle: I'm open to 20% one-time pilot discount with Net45, subject to: 1) signed SOW with milestone definitions, 2) clawback clause to recover unearned discount, 3) cap at $30k. If accepted, finance will authorize billing to apply credit after milestone confirmation.
Harper Ng: Draft clawback language: "If Customer fails to onboard three paying customers within 90 days, Customer shall repay the pro-rated difference between the discount provided and the approved discount amount, invoiced by Redwood Inference."
Luis Moreno: OK from finance if clause and cap included. I'll add approval note to Deal Desk and update BILL-1155.
Dana Park: I'll present 20% / Net45 / $30k cap / clawback. Thanks team.
BillingBot: Note: pending paperwork and milestone confirmation for thread 2250012345 and ticket BILL-1155.
